name: standard
description: WebClerk's standard chart of accounts for a company that buys, makes and sells goods. Loaded once, into a new database; the company then changes its accounts in the chart and its posting roles in the company profile (config.gl_defaults).
numbering: 1xxx assets, 2xxx liabilities, 3xxx equity, 4xxx revenue (49xx contra revenue), 5xxx cost of sales, 6xxx operating expense, 7xxx other income & expense. Code: {number}-{lowercase_words}.

accounts.name: Cash
accounts.summary: Money in the bank. Increases (debit) when a customer pays; decreases (credit) when we pay a vendor or an expense. Reconcile to the bank statement every month. Role: undeposited_funds.

accounts.name: Petty Cash
accounts.summary: Cash kept on hand for small purchases. Refill it from 1000-cash; each refill debits the expenses the receipts show.

accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts.summary: What customers owe us. An invoice debits it for its full total (goods + tax + shipping + other); a customer payment, a credit memo, or a small-balance write-off credits it. Role: accounts_receivable.

accounts.name: Other Receivables
accounts.summary: Money owed to us that is not a customer invoice: manufacturer rebates, employee advances, vendor refunds, insurance claims. Kept out of the customer aging. Role: other_receivables.

accounts.name: Inventory
accounts.summary: Goods on hand, at cost. Receiving a purchase debits it; shipping on an invoice credits it (the cost moves to 5000-cost_of_goods_sold), as do scrap and builds that use components. Role: inventory.

accounts.name: Work in Process
accounts.summary: Parts and labor released to a workorder and not yet built. Release debits it (parts from 1200-inventory, labor estimate from 2160-labor_applied); completion credits it into 1200-inventory. Role: work_in_process.

accounts.name: Prepaid Expenses
accounts.summary: Expenses paid before the months they cover: insurance, rent, annual subscriptions. Each month, credit it and debit the expense for the part used.

accounts.name: Equipment
accounts.summary: Equipment, vehicles and furniture that last more than a year, at what they cost. A capital purchase posts here instead of to an expense.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
accounts.summary: Wear on equipment, taken a little each period. Reduces 1500-equipment on the balance sheet (a contra asset: credit balance). Credited with each debit to 6400-depreciation.

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.summary: What we owe vendors. A vendor bill credits it; paying the vendor debits it. Role: accounts_payable.

accounts.name: Received Not Billed
accounts.summary: Goods received before the vendor has billed us. Credited at receipt (with the debit to 1200-inventory); debited when the bill arrives and moves the amount to 2000-accounts_payable. A balance left over is a receipt and a bill that do not match — investigate it. Role: received_not_billed.

accounts.name: Sales Tax Payable
accounts.summary: Sales tax collected from customers — it belongs to the taxing authority, not to us. Each invoice credits it; paying the tax debits it. Report by jurisdiction. Role: sales_tax_payable.

accounts.name: Payroll Liabilities
accounts.summary: Taxes and deductions withheld from paychecks and the employer taxes owed, until they are paid over. Payroll credits it; each payment to the tax agency or benefit provider debits it.

accounts.name: Labor Applied
accounts.summary: Clearing account for labor estimated into builds. A BOM labor line (hours × factor × rate) credits it at release. Accounting debits actual payroll against it and moves what is left to 5320-labor_variance. Role: labor_applied.

accounts.name: Accrued Liabilities
accounts.summary: Costs already incurred but not yet billed: wages earned since the last payday, utilities used. Credited at period end; cleared when the bill is paid.

accounts.name: Commissions Payable
accounts.summary: Commissions reps have earned and we have not yet paid. Credited when an invoice posts its commission (with 6100-commission_expense); debited when the rep is paid. Role: commission_payable.

accounts.name: Freight Payable
accounts.summary: What we owe carriers for shipments already made. A carrier bill credits it; paying the carrier debits it.

accounts.name: Small-Stings Payable
accounts.summary: What we owe customers for Small-Stings they assessed on us. Filing a sting credits it (debit 6550-small_sting_expense); paying the filing contact in cash debits it. Its own account so the open stings report on their own. Role: small_stings_payable.

accounts.name: Deferred Revenue
accounts.summary: Money received for goods or services not yet delivered: deposits and prepayments. It is owed to the customer until earned, then moves to revenue.

accounts.name: Notes Payable
accounts.summary: Loans due after more than a year. Borrowing credits it; the principal part of each loan payment debits it (the interest part goes to 7200-interest_expense).

accounts.name: Retained Earnings
accounts.summary: Profits kept in the business over the years. At year end the year's net income closes into it. Role: retained_earnings.

accounts.name: Opening Balance Equity
accounts.summary: The other side of stock and balances brought in when the books open (an opening count workorder). Close it to 3000-retained_earnings once the opening is agreed. Role: opening_balance_equity.

accounts.name: Owner Investment
accounts.summary: Money the owners put into the business. Credited when an owner invests.

accounts.name: Owner Draws
accounts.summary: Money the owners take out of the business for themselves — not a business expense. Debited on each draw (a contra equity account: debit balance); closed into 3000-retained_earnings at year end.

accounts.name: Current Year Earnings
accounts.summary: This year's net income so far — revenue minus every cost and expense — shown on the balance sheet. Computed, never posted; closed into 3000-retained_earnings at year end.

accounts.name: Sales
accounts.summary: Revenue from goods sold. Each invoice line credits it for its amount after line discounts. An item or customer can name a more specific revenue account. Role: sales_revenue.

accounts.name: Service Revenue
accounts.summary: Revenue from services and labor billed: consulting, trades, installation, travel, call-outs. Service items name it as their revenue account.

accounts.name: Shipping & Handling Income
accounts.summary: Shipping and handling charged to customers. An invoice's shipping total credits it. What carriers charge us is 5100-freight_in. Role: shipping_revenue.

accounts.name: Finance Charge Income
accounts.summary: Finance charges on past-due customer balances, credited when the monthly assessment posts. Role: finance_charge_income.

accounts.name: Miscellaneous Income
accounts.summary: Income from operations that is not a sale: manufacturer rebates, card surcharges under dual pricing, an invoice's other charges. Role: other_income.

accounts.name: Sales Returns & Allowances
accounts.summary: Goods customers return and price allowances we give. Credit memos debit it, so 4000-sales_revenue keeps the gross figure (a contra revenue account: debit balance).

accounts.name: Sales Discounts
accounts.summary: Early-payment discounts customers take. Debited when a payment is applied with a discount so the invoice closes. Line discounts are not here; lines post net. Role: discount_given.

accounts.name: Small Balance Write-Off
accounts.summary: Leftover balances too small to chase, dismissed when a payment is applied. Debited here, credited to 1100-accounts_receivable. A rounding decision, not a credit loss (that is 6500-bad_debt). Role: small_balance_writeoff.

accounts.name: Cost of Goods Sold
accounts.summary: What the goods on an invoice cost us, at the company costing method. Debited when the invoice posts, with a credit to 1200-inventory. Sales minus this is gross profit. Role: cost_of_goods_sold.

accounts.name: Freight In
accounts.summary: Freight and landed costs to bring goods in. Carrier bills on purchases debit it, unless landed costing adds them to inventory cost.

accounts.name: Scrap & Shrinkage
accounts.summary: Inventory lost to damage, theft or count differences. Debited by scrap and negative adjustments, credited to 1200-inventory — its own account so loss is visible, not buried in cost of goods. Role: scrap.

accounts.name: Inventory Cost Variance
accounts.summary: The difference between the provisional cost used when stock ran short and the actual cost of the stock that filled the shortage. Role: inventory_cost_variance.

accounts.name: Labor Variance
accounts.summary: Actual payroll minus the labor estimated into builds, posted when 2160-labor_applied is reconciled. Role: labor_variance.

accounts.name: Wages & Salaries
accounts.summary: Gross pay before withholding. Payroll debits it; the net pay credits 1000-cash and the withholding credits 2150-payroll_liabilities.

accounts.name: Payroll Taxes
accounts.summary: The employer's share of payroll taxes: Social Security and Medicare match, unemployment. Debited by payroll, credited to 2150-payroll_liabilities.

accounts.name: Commissions
accounts.summary: Commissions reps earn on invoiced sales, debited when an invoice posts its commission, with 2210-commissions_payable. Role: commission_expense.

accounts.name: Professional Fees
accounts.summary: Accountants, lawyers, consultants and other outside professionals.

accounts.name: Rent
accounts.summary: Rent for offices, warehouses and stations.

accounts.name: Repairs & Maintenance
accounts.summary: Repairs and upkeep of equipment, vehicles and premises that keep them working. An improvement that adds years of life is equipment (1500), not a repair.

accounts.name: Utilities
accounts.summary: Electricity, gas, water, internet and phones for the business premises.

accounts.name: Office Supplies & Software
accounts.summary: Office supplies, postage, and software subscriptions.

accounts.name: Depreciation
accounts.summary: This period's share of the cost of equipment. Debited here, credited to 1510-accumulated_depreciation.

accounts.name: Taxes & Licenses
accounts.summary: Business licenses, permits, and property and franchise taxes. Not sales tax (that is owed to the state, 2100) and not payroll taxes (6010) or income tax.

accounts.name: Bad Debt
accounts.summary: Customer balances we will not collect. Writing one off debits it and credits 1100-accounts_receivable (the direct write-off method small businesses use). Role: bad_debt_writeoff.

accounts.name: Small-Sting Expense
accounts.summary: Fines customers assess on us for unresolved problems (Small-Stings): $1.72 unless the sting names its value. Each filing debits it and credits 2230-small_stings_payable. The cost of our errors, in plain sight. Role: small_sting_expense.

accounts.name: Marketing & Advertising
accounts.summary: Advertising, promotion, trade shows and marketing services.

accounts.name: Travel & Meals
accounts.summary: Business travel, lodging and meals. Entertainment is kept apart from meals because the tax rules treat them differently.

accounts.name: Insurance
accounts.summary: Insurance for the current period. Premiums paid ahead sit in 1300-prepaid_expenses until used.

accounts.name: Bank & Card Fees
accounts.summary: Bank charges and card processing fees, debited when a payment settles net of fees.

accounts.name: General & Administrative
accounts.summary: Running costs with no more specific account. Role: default_expense. If it grows, open a specific account for what is in it.

accounts.name: Interest Income
accounts.summary: Interest earned on bank balances and loans we have made.

accounts.name: Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss
accounts.summary: Gains and losses when a foreign-currency invoice is paid at a different exchange rate. A debit is a loss, a credit is a gain; a credit balance is a net gain. Role: fx_gain_loss.

accounts.name: Interest Expense
accounts.summary: Interest paid on loans and credit lines — the interest part of each loan payment on 2500-notes_payable.
